summary.obstruction: for every other alpha <= 60 and every L(alpha) <= r < r_B(alpha) an explicit sequence satisfies LM, FR, Zykov, WR, TAIL and violates ISO_r; the missing ingredient is an upper bound on y = p_{r+1}/p_r that is better than LM's 2(alpha-r)/(r+1) when p_r/p_{r-1} lies in the AM-GM window
summary.theorem_A_prime: ISO_r for every forest on n vertices when (alpha-r) n/alpha <= 2 sqrt(r)
summary.theorem_A_range: ISO_r for every forest when (alpha-r)^2 <= r, i.e. r >= r_A(alpha) = alpha - floor((sqrt(4 alpha+1)-1)/2)
summary.theorem_B: ISO_r for every forest when P_{r,d}(w) = (d+1)(w^2+r)^r - 2^{r-1} d^r w^{r+1} >= 0 on [0, 2(d+1)]; r_B table exact
